name: Developers 2K22
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: The paint was released on May 13th, 2022.
It could have been purchased in the shop from one of the two paint bundles supporting either the Youtubers or Developers from the YouTubers VS Developers event.
